payload.text: hv's keypresses at return, in order: (1) System Settings > Notifications > Menuz: Allow (the first launch's alert was withdrawn when the hand run quit the app; macOS counts that as no; the running copy then posts); tell vc, who reruns the notice hand run for AT-06.4. (2) Log out and in: the menu is back (the login item is enabled); tell vc for AT-05.2's note. (3) bin/devbin macos store-creds, then vc runs app-sign, app-notarize, app-verify and publish for the Menuz.app.zip asset. (4) The tap: git -C $(brew --repository matthewsinclair/utilz) commit -am 'utilz 2.13.0' && git -C ... push, then the same for 2.14.0 after the cut (vc copies and audits the formula). (5) .claude/settings.json's advisory: ! intent claude upgrade --apply.
